description: On the green bedspread in front of you there’s a pile of multicolored plastic beads, a red string with some blue beads already on it, and a black tape dispenser nearby. The left hand holds and steadies the red string near the bottom center while the right hand reaches into the bead pile on the right, pinches a single bead, brings it toward the string, and then both hands come together to guide the bead onto the string and slide it down, with the bead becoming a two-hand object briefly as it’s threaded.
